svg.aria-label: Drawn scene: three goals side by side on one ground line: a site office improving how L&T works, equipment and a customer accepting a better offer, and a new team with a paying customer; beneath them the AI tools L&T already has.
svg.text: Three goals, side by side · not stages
The team that does the work keeps the decision
And new products inside its businesses
